description: Get one of GateOnAI's 2,957 pre-built, ready-made AI workflows for a specific profession - a deterministic, ordered sequence of steps each matched to a real tool by category and GateOnAI Score, regenerated live from current tool data. Different from get_ai_workflow: this returns an existing, pre-built template for a known profession rather than generating a new custom one from free text - faster and more consistent for common roles.

profession.description: Profession slug. Examples: 'blogger', 'general-contractor', 'marketing-manager', 'software-developer', '3d-artist'. If unsure of the exact slug, use get_ai_workflow instead with a free-text description.

name: get_workflow_template

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Get Pre-Built Workflow Template
